title: Iran, Russia reaffirm commitment to strategic cooperation
description: Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei and Russian President Vladimir Putin have reaffirmed their commitment to continuing strategic cooperation in line with a roadmap established by the two countries’ top leaders.

title: Chinese foreign minister says Beijing supports Iran’s sovereignty and security
description: Tehran, IRNA – China supports Iran in safeguarding its national sovereignty and security and opposes a return to military confrontation in the Middle East, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said during a meeting with Ali Bagheri, deputy secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, in Beijing on Monday.

title: Exclusive | Araghchi says Iran ‘more prepared’ for diplomacy and war; warns US to choose ‘wise path’
description: Ashgabat, IRNA - Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Iran is prepared for both diplomatic and military scenarios “more than ever before,” stating that the ball is now in Washington’s court to choose between a “wise path” of negotiation or repeating the “mistake of military aggression.”

title: Another offending tanker catches fire after striking mines east of Hormuz
description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s Army Navy says another non-compliant oil tanker caught fire on Monday morning local time, after striking mines while sailing through an unauthorized and unsafe route east of the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Economy minister seeks Islamic cooperation to counter US economic pressure
description: Tehran, IRNA – Economy Minister Ali Madanizadeh says he plans to hold bilateral talks with counterparts from other Islamic countries to strengthen economic cooperation and counter US efforts to intensify economic pressure on Tehran.

title: Eleven offending oil tankers catch fire in Strait of Hormuz in nine days: IRGC Navy
description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy says 11 offending oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz within nine days, from October 25 to November 2.

title: US aggression puts livelihoods of Iranian fishermen in danger: Official
description: Tehran, IRNA – The CEO of the Qeshm Fishermen’s Cooperative says US military aggression against Iran has threatened fishermen’s livelihoods, destroyed fishing boats and vessels, and killed several fishermen.

title: Israel’s expansionist ambitions greatest threat to region: Jordan King
description: Tehran, IRNA - Jordan’s King Abdullah II has described the Zionist regime’s expansionist ambitions as the greatest threat to the region and its nations.

title: Bagheri Kani visits Beijing for talks with Chinese officials
description: Tehran, IRNA –  Ali Bagheri Kani, deputy for international affairs at the Secretariat of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, has traveled to Beijing to meet and hold consultations with senior Chinese officials.

title: Ex-FM Kharrazi remembered for promoting knowledge-based foreign policy
description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s foreign policy should be grounded in scientific knowledge and long-term strategic thinking, says Secretary of the Strategic Council on Foreign Relations Jalal Dehghani Firouzabadi, paying tribute to former diplomat Kamal Kharrazi.

title: Iran seeks regional partnerships to bolster food security: Deputy foreign minister
description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran is ready to expand scientific, trade, and investment cooperation in agriculture with countries in the region and beyond, Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi says, describing agricultural diplomacy as a means of securing sustainable food supplies.

title: Former football player Hamid Alidoosti passes away
description: Hamid Alidoosti, a former Iran national football team player and one of the country’s standout forwards, has died at 70 following years in football and a struggle with illness.

title: Iran, Turkmenistan seek to expand transit, regional cooperation
description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran and Turkmenistan are seeking to strengthen transport and transit cooperation, bolster regional connectivity and develop trade ties, Iran’s ambassador to Turkmenistan says.

title: In Photos: Iran hosts halal congress
description: The Iran International Halal Congress took place in Tehran on November 2, 2026, with the participation of Iranian officials and prominent religious figures.

title: Iran judges US by actions, not tone of letters: Baqaei
description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says Tehran judges Washington by the actions of its government, not the tone of its correspondence, warning that the United States has repeatedly undermined diplomatic efforts over the past two years.

title: Iran, Turkmenistan review developing all-out ties
description: Ashgabat, IRNA – Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and his Turkmen counterpart Raşit Meredow discussed ways to expand bilateral, regional, and international relations.

title: In photos: Persepolis volleyball team training session
description: Persepolis volleyball squad trained on November 1, 2026, at Saipa Cultural and Athletic Corporation.

title: Araghchi: Iran’s conditions are all feasible if US seeks peaceful solution
description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Iran’s conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz are all feasible if the United States demonstrates goodwill, has a genuine willingness to reach an agreement, and truly seeks a peaceful solution.

title: Iranian wrestlers scoop 15 medals, set records at world championships
description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s freestyle and Greco-Roman teams won 15 medals, including six gold, four silver and five bronze, at the 2026 World Wrestling Championships in Kazakhstan. Iran was the only nation to reach the team podium in both disciplines.

title: Iran FM arrives in Ashgabat
description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has arrived in Ashgabat, the capital of Turkmenistan, to hold talks with the country’s officials.

title: Two offending oil tankers catch fire after hitting mine in unauthorized Hormuz route: Iran
description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy says two more oil tankers caught fire after an explosion as they were attempting to pass through an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Iran’s defense doctrine no longer bound by ‘geography of a threat’: Leader’s advisor
description: Tehran, IRNA - Mohammad Mokhber, senior advisor and aide to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, said in a message that Iran’s defense doctrine is rapidly evolving and that the geography of a threat no longer determines the geography of the response.

title: People in Abadan bid farewell to ship captain martyred in US attack
description: Abadan, IRNA - A farewell ceremony for the body of Nasser Ebrahimi-Nejadan, the captain of a vessel who was martyred in an attack by the American enemy in the open waters of the Persian Gulf, was held in Abadan on Sunday evening.

title: Pakistan embassy rejects rumors of attack on ambassador
description: Tehran, IRNA - The Pakistani Embassy in Tehran has issued a statement dismissing rumors circulating about an attack on the country's ambassador.

title: Russian official calls for stronger Tehran-Moscow ties to protect shared interests
description: Ahvaz, IRNA – The head of the Russian-Iranian Council for Trade Relations, Rajab Safarov, has stressed the need to expand bilateral cooperation, saying closer ties in economic, political, and security fields would strengthen the two countries’ positions and protect their shared interests.

title: Foreign Minister Araghchi to visit Turkmenistan on Monday
description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is scheduled to travel to Ashgabat on Monday, heading a diplomatic and economic delegation.

title: No breakthrough yet in consultations with Qatari mediator over Hormuz plan: Araghchi
description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, referring to the talks between an Iranian delegation and the Qatari mediators in Doha, says although consultations over a “two-day plan” on reopening the Strait of Hormuz continue, but a definitive outcome has not been reached yet.

title: Iranian envoy derides European concerns over economic fallout of US-Israeli aggression
description: London – Iran’s ambassador to Germany has criticized Western governments for remaining silent over the US-Israeli military aggression against Iran, saying they are now expressing concern about the economic consequences of the same aggression for their own countries.

title: 86th Naval Flotilla’s voyage a historic achievement, says Iranian Navy commander
description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Navy commander Rear Admiral Shahram Irani has described the 86th Naval Flotilla’s voyage as a historic achievement, saying it was the result of months of planning.

title: Leader’s directive paves the way for complete deterrence: IRGC spokesperson
description: Kerman, IRNA – The spokesperson for the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC), referring to a recent order from the Leader of the Islamic Revolution to respond swiftly and forcefully to any new aggression, says the removal of geographical limits in targeting enemies paves the way for complete deterrence.

title: Displaced in Hebron: Picking up pieces after Israeli siege
description: Displaced Hebron families return to damaged homes, left to pick up scattered pieces of their lives after Israeli siege.
